name: What is the process for reserving a pre-construction unit?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for reserving a pre-construction unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for reserving a pre-construction unit typically starts with a reservation agreement and a deposit, which secures your chosen unit for a specific period. During this time, you'll review the developer's plans, finishes, and contract details. This initial reservation allows you time to conduct due diligence, including financial planning, before committing to a purchase contract. Our agents assist in navigating this crucial early stage, ensuring you understand all terms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Reserving a pre-construction unit involves a reservation agreement and deposit, allowing time for due diligence before signing a purchase contract.
